name: Calder Precision Engineering
summary: CNC machining subcontractor supplying aerospace and automotive customers. Set in 2012.

company.name: Calder Precision Engineering Ltd
company.description: A 60-person CNC machining and fabrication subcontractor in Halifax, AS9100 and ISO 9001 certified, making precision parts for aerospace, automotive and food-machinery customers. Customers send purchase orders and drawings, chase deliveries, raise quality non-conformances and query invoices. Steel and aluminium prices have risen sharply, a 5-axis machine has been down for a week, and a major automotive customer is pushing for a 3% price reduction.
